queries.irsa_tap_2mass: SELECT designation, ra, dec, j_m, h_m, k_m FROM fp_psc WHERE designation = '09591989+3000275'
queries.gaia_tap: SELECT TOP 1 source_id, pmra, pmdec, phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 149.83288600, 30.00764100, 0.00138889)) ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag
queries.irsa_tap_coverage: SELECT a.uri, p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_lower, p.time_bounds_upper, p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 149.83288600, 30.00764100), p.poly) ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
